sql_query:
SELECT
  LEFT(c.customer_unique_id, 10) AS customer_unique_id,
  LEFT(s.seller_id, 10) AS seller_id,
  AVG(ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date::timestamp - o.order_delivered_carrier_date::timestamp)))/86400.0) AS avg_delivery_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS customers_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
WHERE
  o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  LEFT(c.customer_unique_id, 10),
  LEFT(s.seller_id, 10)
ORDER BY
  LEFT(c.customer_unique_id, 10),
  LEFT(s.seller_id, 10);
